excerpts.excerpt:
IfMatch:
      name: If-Match
      in: header
      required: true
      description: |
        Strong ETag of the resource as last read, `"<resource_version>"` (§14.5).
        Missing: 428 PRECONDITION_REQUIRED. Mismatch: 412
        RESOURCE_VERSION_CONFLICT with details.current_resource_version.
      schema:
        type: string
        pattern: '^"(0|[1-9][0-9]*)"$'
        maxLength: 22

PreconditionFailed:
      description: RESOURCE_VERSION_CONFLICT. Re-read the resource; details.current_resource_version holds the current version.
      headers:
        X-Request-ID:
          $ref: '#/components/headers/X-Request-ID'
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelope'
    PayloadTooLarge:
      description: PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE. Body or batch exceeds the configured limit.
